errors.text_span: x轴未提供明确的文字标签（代表年份）
errors.evidence: The statement that the x-axis has no explicit text labels is incorrect. The axis has clear numerical labels for the years (1946, 1948, 1950, etc.), which explicitly denote the time period.

errors.text_span: 在1994至1996年间微降至0以下（约-1）
errors.evidence: The dotted line does not drop below 0 in the 1994-1996 period. It remains at or very slightly above the zero line. The value of approximately -1 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: 最终在2018年以约-2的值结束
errors.evidence: While the dotted line does end at a slightly negative value in 2018, -2 is an overestimation. The value is visually closer to -1.
